title: RecurringEvents Temporal Expression
description: A recurring-event rule, implementing Martin Fowler's "Recurring Events for Calendars" pattern (Fowler & Yoder, PLoP 1997). Every node is discriminated by its `type` field. Matches the RETemporalExpression class hierarchy in RecurringEvents-Core one-to-one; produced/consumed by RETemporalExpression>>asJsonString / class>>fromJsonString:.

dateAndTime.description: A single, fixed occurrence. Maps to REDateAndTimeExpression.

duration.description: Recurs indefinitely every fixed elapsed duration starting at `start`. Maps to REDurationExpression. `every` is an ISO 8601 duration restricted to the day/hour/minute/second units (no Y/M calendar units, which are ambiguous as a fixed elapsed duration - use the calendar expressions below for those).

dayInWeek.description: Includes every date whose weekday is in the set, e.g. "every Monday and Wednesday". Maps to REDayInWeekExpression.

monthInYear.description: Includes every date whose month is in the set, e.g. "June, July, August". Maps to REMonthInYearExpression.

dayInMonth.description: Two mutually exclusive modes, matching REDayInMonthExpression. `day` mode: a fixed calendar day number, e.g. 1 for "the 1st"; negative counts from month end (-1 = last day). `ordinal`+`weekday` mode: the nth occurrence of a weekday in the month, e.g. ordinal 4 + weekday thursday for "the 4th Thursday" (Thanksgiving); negative ordinal counts from month end (-1 = "the last Monday", Memorial Day).

rangeEachYear.description: Includes every date within a month/day range, recurring every year. If `start` is later in the year than `end` (e.g. December 15 to January 15), the range wraps across the year boundary. Maps to RERangeEachYearExpression.

union.description: Includes a date if ANY of the sub-expressions includes it. Maps to REUnionTemporalExpression.

intersection.description: Includes a date if ALL of the sub-expressions include it. Maps to REIntersectionTemporalExpression. Composing monthInYear + dayInMonth this way expresses e.g. Thanksgiving (4th Thursday of November) or Memorial Day (last Monday of May).

difference.description: Includes a date if `included` includes it AND `excluded` does not, e.g. "every Monday, except holidays". Maps to REDifferenceTemporalExpression.
